title: Aligning to Thousands of Preferences via System Message Generalization
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates 'Morality' as one of the four core dimensions for its 'MULTIFACETED COLLECTION' dataset and 'MULTIFACETED BENCH' evaluation.
